_comment: Command refusal kojo `<COM>_Refuse` (Plan_KojoTemplates.md §7.11, wired §7.13 W1): for a refused EP the engine tries `<COM>_Refuse` first (RelationshipManager.GetKOJOMessage - the whole key chain: own, kojo source, folder parent, fallback personality), then `<COM>`. Fetched only for a refused EP, so every branch must not require success (requireEPSuccess false, or requireEPFailure true) - a branch with the default requireEPSuccess true never passes here. A refusing speaker is awake (sleepers / time-stopped / restrained always accept, EVP_Modifiers). useActiveTags false is right here (T-D15).
